data.name: Ghufayrah
data.gender_notes: Ghufayrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ghufayrah is derived from the Arabic word 'Ghafara' which means to forgive, to pardon, or to cover up. It implies graciousness, kindness, and a generous nature. The name Ghufayrah carries the meaning “Gracious, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Ghufayrah usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the essence of forgiveness and kindness, Ghufayrah is a name that reflects a spiritual connection with Allah's attributes of mercy and compassion.
data.etymology: Ghufayrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghufayrah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: غُفَيْرَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الغُفيرَة: اسم نباتي، يعود أصلها إلى الجذر الغفَر، والغفرة هي اسم للنبات، ومعناه الغفلة والغفران. ومِنها قَولُهُ تعالى: {وَلَقَدْ غَفَرْنَا لَهُ مِن ذُنُوبِهِ} [الإسراء: 82].

in_urdu.name: غُفَيْرَة
in_urdu.meaning: غفیرہ، غفیریں، پودے کا نام، غفیریں
in_urdu.long_meaning: غفیرہ: پودے کا نام، اس کا تعلق Arabic جڑی سے ہے، اور پودے کی نام غفیرہ ہے۔ اور اس کا مطلب غفلت اور غفران ہے۔ اور اسی طرح یہ کہا گیا ہے کہ رب تعالیٰ نے اس کے لئے معاف کیا {وَلَقَدْ غَفَرْنَا لَهُ مِن ذُنُوبِهِ} [الإسراء: 82].

in_hindi.name: गुफैरा
in_hindi.meaning: गुफीरा, गुफीरे, पौधे का नाम, गुफीरे
in_hindi.long_meaning: गुफीरा: पौधे का नाम, इसका संबंध अरबी जड़ी से है, और पौधे का नाम गुफीरा है। और इसका अर्थ गफलता और गफरन है। और इसी तरह यह कहा गया है कि अल्लाह ने इसे अपने पापों से माफ कर दिया {वलकद गफर्ना लहु मिन जुनुबिहि} [इसराए: 82].

in_pashto.name: غُفَيْرَة
in_pashto.long_meaning: غفيره: نباتي نوم، يې د غفَر جګر څخه اخستل شوي، چې د غفيراتو څخه يو نوم دی، چې د غفلتو او غفرانو په مانا دی. او ځانګړې د الله تعالى د فرمان په بڼه دا ده: {ولقد غفرنا له مين ذنوبیه} [الإسراء: 82].

in_english.name: Ghufayrah
in_english.long_meaning: Ghufayrah: plant name, its origin is from the Arabic root ghafar, and ghufayra is the name of the plant, and its meaning is forgetfulness and forgiveness. and from the verse of Allah {And indeed, We have forgiven him from his sins} [Isra: 82].

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic context, Ghufayrah is believed to be an Arabic female given name which holds great cultural significance. It signifies forgiveness, and kindness, traits which are held in high esteem in Islamic culture. Naming a child Ghufayrah is an expression of the hope that the child will embody these qualities, fostering positive relationships and creating a peaceful and harmonious community. It is also worth mentioning that this name might be considered particularly meaningful during the holy month of Ramadan, a period marked by forgiveness, compassion, and self-improvement in the Islamic faith.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Ghufayrah' conveys deeper meanings. It underscores Allah's infinite mercy, as exemplified through the continuous forgiveness offered to believers. When using this name in prayer, it serves as a constant reminder of the importance of following the path of forgiveness and showing kindness towards others. It carries a message of reconciliation and hope, encouraging individuals to seek Allah's forgiveness and extend forgiveness to those around them. Ultimately, Ghufayrah represents the power of compassion, understanding, and unwavering faith, providing a spiritual foundation that promotes personal growth, emotional intelligence, and an enlightened understanding of life's complexities.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Ghufayrah in Arabic means "the one who is protective and guardian". In the spiritual sense, it represents a person who shields and safeguards the faith, values, and beliefs of others, just as the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) was a protective shield and guide for his community.
